title: BioIVT: psoriasis oral steroid dose amount is a number
description: Changes the Dose question for the oral steroid on the Psoriasis form from free text to a decimal number. The unit is a separate pick list question.
rationale: A dose amount is a number, not a choice (approved choice-list rule 4). Existing free-text values such as '10 mg' will need matching during data migration.
source: BIOIVT_BEFORE_AFTER.html Phase 1 plan, approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 1 build. Approved by Dan after reviewing the before/after page.
